free_tier.stated: Quoted: 'The Thiel Fellowship gives $250,000 to young people who want to build new things instead of sitting in a classroom.' The shape, quoted: 'Two years. $250,000. Some ideas can't wait.' and 'Thiel Fellows skip or stop out of college to receive a $250,000 grant and support from the Thiel Foundation's network of founders, investors, and scientists.' No entity is required: the award is to a person, and the page's own terms of trade are quoted as 'How you spend your two years in the Fellowship is up to you'.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: Cash with no stated spending restriction, so at Lambda's documented on-demand rate of USD 3.99 per H100 GPU-hour (dossier/compute/lambda.json) USD 250,000 is about 62,500 H100-hours across two years. It composes with every compute record in the corpus for the same reason the Eigenprize does, and it is the only award denominated in years rather than weeks.

limits.value: an age and enrolment condition decides it before any project does: the fellowship is for people young enough to 'skip or stop out of college', which excludes anyone past that stage regardless of what they can build.
